name: Malin's Request
summary: In Stormwind, Skuerto's letter carries news from Arathi to Archmage Malin. You are sent to the Mage Quarter with word that Kryten and Skuerto will soon be home.

sections.title: A Letter for the Archmage
sections.body: After your work in Arathi, Skuerto gives you a sealed letter for Archmage Malin in Stormwind's Mage Quarter. It says Kryten and Skuerto will be home soon. Skuerto trusts Malin will repay you well for helping them and wishes you a safe journey.

sections.title: Malin Reads the Letter
sections.body: Archmage Malin opens Skuerto's letter, and his eyes grow wide. Delighted, he says Trelane will be pleased. Malin supposes Kryten and Skuerto share his excitement as they head home to Stormwind.

faq.q: Who sends you with the letter?
faq.answer: Skuerto sends you with a letter for Malin. It says Kryten and Skuerto will be home soon.

aliases: where do i turn this in
faq.answer: Archmage Malin is in Stormwind's Mage Quarter.
Kryten is Skuerto's companion in the Arathi Highlands. Skuerto says they will be home soon.
This follows Attack on the Tower, the work Skuerto asked you to do at the tower in Arathi.
